label: Radio Frequency & Electronics
brief: Create five clean, futuristic hardware vectors: QAM constellation grid, antenna dipole radiation, logic gate array, RLC resonance filter, and clock signal eye diagram.

items.name: QAM Constellation
items.description: 16-point quadrature amplitude modulation constellation grid in I/Q phase space.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a symmetric 4x4 grid of luminous constellation points plotted on orthogonal I/Q coordinate axes; no numbers or text.

items.name: Antenna Radiation Pattern
items.description: Toroidal dipole antenna radiating electromagnetic wave lobes.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a vertical central dipole antenna element radiating symmetric figure-8 electromagnetic toroidal power lobes; no text.

items.name: Logic Gate Array
items.description: Interconnected digital logic gate circuit with clean schematic routing traces.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a stylized geometric digital logic gate network with interconnected orthogonal circuit traces and node junctions; no text.

items.name: RLC Resonance Tank
items.description: Tuned LC resonant frequency response curve with sharp quality-factor peak.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a sharp resonant frequency response curve with a narrow bandpass peak and minimal baseline axis; no text or numbers.

items.name: Clock Jitter Eye Diagram
items.description: Superimposed high-speed digital transitions forming an open eye diagram.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a clean geometric high-speed digital signal eye diagram with intersecting rising and falling clock edge transitions forming an open central diamond; no text.
